title: Legal Counsel - Privacy
posting_excerpt:
t with privacy and data-protection laws around the world, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM so the company can expand into new markets without slowing down. This is a build role: you will stand up the privacy program that lets a public-sector platform operate globally, and your judgment will directly shape what TRM can ship and where it can operate.

The impact you will have:

 - Determine whether TRM can launch Orion in a new jurisdiction by owning the privacy analysis end-to-end — using AI to draft DPIAs and transfer assessments so decisions land in days, not weeks.

 - Embed privacy-by-design into Orion's development lifecycle, partnering with Engineering to resolve data-flow and retention questions before they become launch blockers.

 - Lead and respond to data subject rights requests (DSARs) in coordination with Engineering and Customer Success.

 - Build and maintain the privacy program's core artifacts — records of processing, DPIA templates, and breach-response playbooks — using AI-assisted workflows so the program scales without adding headcount.

 - Run first-pass review of data processing agreements with AI, then finalize positions, cutting turnaround time on customer and vendor DPAs.

 - Design lawful cross-border data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, transfer impact assessments) that let Orion serve international customers with confidence.

 - Stand up a self-service privacy-review intake, supported by AI triage, so routine questions are answered quickly and only genuinely novel risk reaches deep legal review.

 - Support the CLO and AGC with clear, business-ready guidance that helps leadership make faster, better-informed decisions on privacy risk.

What we're looking for:

 - 4+ years of privacy and data-protection legal experience, with hands-on work applying GDPR and US state privacy laws to a technology product.

 - Active US bar admission; JD from an ABA-accredited law school.

 - Proven AI fluency: you use Claude, Gemini, or equivalent tools in your daily workflow and can design AI-assisted privacy processes — not just use AI for one-off research.

 - Experience counseling Product and Engineering teams on privacy-by-design, DPIAs, and data flows.

 - Familiarity with cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy analysis).

 - A collaborative, business-minded approach: you explain privacy risk in plain terms and work with partners to find a path forward rather than defaulting to no.

 - Comfort operating with ownership and limited oversight in a fast-moving environment.

About the Team:

 - TRM Legal is a lean, high-trust team that operates with high ownership and minimal hierarchy; each counsel owns their domain and is expected to advise proactively.

 - The Financial Times recently recognized the team as one of the "Most Innovative In-House Legal Teams" in North America, and the team is led by TRM's CLO, a former senior DOJ official.

 - AI tool adoption is a shared expectation — the team actively uses the Claude suite and similar tools to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

 - Legal partners with Product, Engineering, and GTM as a business accelerator, not a bottleneck; you will be in the room shaping decisions early, not looped in after the fact.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - The team is distributed across US time zones with core overlap during standard business hours; primary communication is async-first via Slack, with key decisions documented in Notion — distributed, not distant.

 - Weekly Legal team sync for cross-functional coordination; regular 1:1s with the AGC for prioritization and privacy program advisory.

 - TRM operates a high-transparency culture — program status and obligations are tracked in shared workspaces accessible to partner teams.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Within the first 30 days, complete a full privacy assessment of an Orion feature and give Engineering a clear, actionable path to ship on schedule.
